summary: Compact square motor controller housing with four corner mounting holes, a wire harness, and a status indicator on the top face.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat underside of the housing, used to mount against a plate with the four corner holes
Top face with the printed label area and status indicator

notes: No dimensions are given in the text or drawings. The size is estimated from the photo by comparing the housing with the included 20 mm M4 screws and the mm ruler on the cutting mat. The 48 x 48 x 14 mm body is a rough estimate. The four corner holes are assumed to be M4 clearance (about 4.2 mm) because the kit includes M4 screws. The hole spacing of 40 mm is a guess, assumed to follow the 8 mm pattern. Wires and connectors are excluded from the bounds.
